improvement_detail: O(L) per query independent of t vs O(L t) simulation; indicative timings
statement: The burn-time fast-forward of the fuse magma (Theorem 4) is exact and takes O(L) time for every t - 1.4-5.3x faster than direct simulation at t = 100 (L = 256-4096) and about 4000x at t = 10^5 (L = 1024); t = 10^9 in about 0.6 ms (L = 1024).
title: Fuse fast-forward by burn times
